reason: A web-interface plugin that visualizes token usage, cache metrics, provider and model breakdowns, daily activity, and session-level request records in a draggable overlay panel.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可拖动的浮动面板，用于查看 Token 用量、缓存指标、提供商与模型明细、每日活动及会话记录。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable overlay to the DeepSeek Harness web interface for viewing token usage, cache metrics, provider and model breakdowns, daily activity, and session records.

capabilities: Reads token usage and session statistics from the host application
Aggregates provider, model, session, and request-level usage data
Serves aggregated data through a local HTTP route
Injects a draggable browser overlay panel into the host web interface
Writes plugin files and a plugin configuration entry during installation
